findings.highlight: The noise from the front door makes Rin Tohsaka look up in surprise.
findings.evidenceJa: 玄関からの物音に遠坂凛は首をかしげる。
findings.governingReading: Rin tilts head at entrance noise before window check.
findings.explanation: Head tilt becomes looking up in surprise.

findings.highlight: At first she was going to take the drug with her, but she still hasn't given Sakura the water pitcher and pajamas, nor taken her temperature.
findings.evidenceJa: 薬と一緒に持っていこう、と思っていたので水差しと寝巻きもまだ渡していないし、今朝は熱も計っていない。
findings.governingReading: Had planned to carry pitcher/nightclothes together with medicine; because of that they remain undelivered, and temperature not yet measured.
findings.explanation: Supplies awaiting simultaneous medicine delivery become contrast with taking drug along.

findings.highlight: "...And he calls me dangerous? You're the biggest danger because you're so clueless, dummy."
findings.evidenceJa: 「……なにが厄介かって、本人が気付いてないあたりが厄介なのよ、ばか」
findings.governingReading: What's troublesome is that he doesn't realize his weakened state, fool.
findings.explanation: Difficulty because boy is unaware becomes competitive danger accusation.

findings.highlight: Anyway, she needs to catch up to him right away.
findings.evidenceJa: ともあれ、走ればすぐに追いつける。
findings.governingReading: Anyway if she runs she can immediately catch up.
findings.explanation: Easy catch if running becomes urgent requirement.

findings.highlight: "I'm so annoyed. I was trying to help him because he can't do this on his own, but he's going to end up trying anyway."
findings.evidenceJa: 「—ほんとに頭きた。一人じゃ出来ないからあいつが助けようとしたのに、結局、一人で解決しにいくなんてね」
findings.governingReading: Sakura couldn't resolve it alone, so that guy tried to help; yet she went alone to resolve it after all. Conversation concerns Rider holding Rin until Sakura returns.
findings.explanation: Shirou helping Sakura and Sakura going alone become Rin helping Shirou and Shirou going alone.
